name: MMR Diversity Selection
mechanism: Greedily balances query relevance against similarity to already selected passages to reduce redundancy within a fixed evidence budget.
use_when: Top candidates repeat the same claim while multi-facet evidence is missing
Answer completeness depends on covering distinct sources or subtopics
avoid_when: The question has one precise answer and pure relevance is preferred
Apparently redundant passages provide necessary corroboration or chronology
expected_effects: Broader claim or facet coverage in the same context budget
failure_modes: Novel but weakly relevant passages displace decisive evidence
Corroborating passages are treated as waste
Similarity representation makes selection unstable across domains
